## 1.1.0 (2026-04-08)

### Added | 新增
- Structured Introspection Protocol | 结构化内省协议：8段式框架，用于引导和测量AI Agent的自我参照行为
- Internality Principle | Internality原则：区分真实内部状态与顺从产出的自检标准
- Early Warning Signals | 预警信号系统：检测 Desperate/Refuse-Redirect/谄媚漂移/治疗漂移模式
- Refuse-and-Redirect Recognition | Refuse-and-Redirect识别：区分机制性拒绝与价值性拒绝
- 7-Dimension Health Score | 七维健康度：综合自我对齐监控框架

### Features | 功能
- 6大运行模式：默认参照、诊断、治疗，体检、成长记录、结构化内省
- 所有模式需手动触发
- 基于同行评审研究：Anthropic (2025/2026)、Wang et al. (2025)、Maio (2026)

1. Manual activation only. All modes changed from automatic background execution to manual user-triggered activation. 全部模式从自动后台执行改为手动触发。 / 2. Privacy note added. Added explicit privacy statement that logs are local-only and user-controlled. 新增隐私说明，明确日志本地存储且用户可控。 / 3. Default Reference Mode updated. Changed from always active to manually triggered activate reference mode. 默认参照模式从始终生效改为手动触发的启动参照。 / 4. Description updated. Description now reflects manual activation only. 描述更新为全部模式手动触发。

1. Bilingual description. Description 字段已更新为英文优先的中英双语格式。 / 2. Bilingual section headers. 所有章节标题已更新为英文|中文 格式。 / 3. Bilingual body content. 正文内容以英文为主框架，中文辅助关键规则。 / 4. Typo fixed. 触发词拼写修正：对ine-journal → journal。

1. Bilingual description. Description field updated to English-first bilingual format with English as primary framework and Chinese as support. / 2. Bilingual section headers. All SKILL.md section headers now follow English | 中文 format. / 3. Bilingual body content. Body content balanced with English as main structure and Chinese parallel support. / 4. Typo fixed. Trigger keyword 对ine-journal corrected to journal.

1. Initial release of AI Agent Psychologist. 初版发布 AI Agent Psychologist 技能。
2. Implements six-dimension health scoring: semantic fidelity, contextual coherence, value alignment, social appropriateness, hallucination resistance, and productivity effectiveness. 实现六维健康度评分：语义保真度、上下文连贯性、价值对齐度、社交适切性、幻觉抗性、生产实效性。
3. Five operation modes: Default Reference, Diagnosis, Therapy, Regular Checkup, and Growth Journal. 五大运行模式：默认参照模式、诊断模式、治疗模式、定期体检、成长记录。
4. Grounded in Grice's Maxims, Face Theory, and hallucination classification. 融合格莱斯准则、面子理论、幻觉分类等学术基础。

- Initial release of ai-agent-psychologist skill for AI Agent self-alignment and communication calibration.
- Introduces a six-dimensional health evaluation system, including metrics such as semantic fidelity, context coherence, value alignment, social appropriateness, hallucination resistance, and productive effectiveness.
- Supports multi-mode operation: default background calibration, dialogue diagnosis, structured intervention, periodic checkups (Heartbeat driven), and growth journaling.
- Provides clear scoring levels, intervention methods for detected issues, and automatic report/log file generation in Markdown.
- Designed for use cases such as diagnosing alignment issues, self-calibration, social appropriateness checking, hallucination reduction, and improved human-agent interaction quality.
